access_links.label: CAMBER provider pointer and access conditions

description: Be-Mobile supplies map-matched GPS observations from connected vehicles for traffic monitoring, route planning and historical mobility analysis. Its national access-point metadata describes Belgian and Dutch coverage and a one-minute update frequency; the CAMBER pointer describes a wider European feed concentrated in the Benelux and three years of retained data without fixed start or end dates. FlowCheck uses the historical observations for route, segment, origin-destination and map analyses. These sources establish the same provider-level resource, not an identical geographic extract. Access is commercial: fresh provider-supplied registry metadata says fee required and closed licence, while the CAMBER record is restricted and offers access on request. Its CC BY4.0 deposit declaration is not assumed to license the underlying commercial feed. No feed values were read. Observation counts, export schemas and product-specific terms remain unknown. The data support network flow and capacity planning; related resource is the Belgian national access point.
